_comment: Game profiles registry. Each profile maps topology families to named affinity strategies. The resolver (_GameProfile.ps1) detects the live topology family and picks the strategy. To add a new game, copy the BDO entry and edit processName + affinityStrategy. Strategy names are documented in _GameProfile.ps1.

_strategyReference.AllCores: Use every core with SMT enabled.
_strategyReference.AllPCoresKeepHT: P-cores only on Intel hybrid; keep HT. All cores on non-hybrid.
_strategyReference.AllPCoresNoHT: P-cores only, one LP per core (disables HT in software).
_strategyReference.AllCoresNoSMT: All cores, one LP each (disables SMT in software).
_strategyReference.AllCoresNoSMTSkipCore0: All cores except the one owning LP 0, SMT off.
_strategyReference.SixPCoresNoHTSkipCore0: Up to 6 P-cores, skip core 0, no HT. Intel classic BDO recipe.
_strategyReference.BDO-Aggressive: BDO hybrid-Intel recipe: 6 P-cores, no HT, skip core 0, no E-cores. Matches 13900K 0x1554.
_strategyReference.VCacheCCDOnly-NoSMT: AMD X3D dual-CCD: pin to V-Cache die, SMT off.
_strategyReference.FirstCCDOnly-NoSMT: Isolate to first CCD on multi-CCD AMD (non-X3D).
_strategyReference.SecondCCDOnly-NoSMT-SixCores: Isolate to second CCD, cap at 6 cores, SMT off. BDO guide convention for Ryzen 9 non-X3D.

profiles.notes: Based on ACanadianDude's Ultimate BDO Performance Guide plus community testing. BDO does not benefit from SMT/HT and regresses with >6 active P-cores after extended play. On AMD X3D dual-CCD parts the V-Cache die is strongly preferred (large shared L3 benefits BDO's open-world asset access).

defaultProfile._comment: Conservative default for unknown games. Only restricts to P-cores on Intel hybrid (E-cores hurt most games due to lower clocks and smaller cache) and pins to V-Cache CCD on AMD X3D dual-CCD (where Xbox Game Bar's auto-detect may not have flagged this game).
defaultProfile.notes: Safe baseline. Not every game benefits from affinity tuning — many are hurt by it. Only the two cases with clear evidence (E-core avoidance on hybrid Intel, V-Cache preference on AMD X3D) are applied.
